text: Plan: create docs/DEVPLAN.md with an ordered, gated bring-up procedure, verified net/pad probe map, measurable acceptance criteria, risk register and a review-only prototype ordering plan. Add a current-stage pointer/status in docs/SPEC.md and record the new planning constraints and decisions. No hardware, BOM, KiCad source, exports or firmware will change. Preserve the strict current/load/voltage/cost targets, four intrinsic J1 DRC errors, conditional budgets and every unperformed physical qualification; document preparation never authorizes procurement, fabrication or energized testing.

args.why: Complete the original eighth pipeline stage with a usable, safety-gated prototype bring-up and order plan that preserves actual software evidence and all unresolved physical-release conditions.
args.what_changes:
- Create docs/DEVPLAN.md with pre-fabrication hold points, ordered unpowered and powered bring-up, real net/pad probe locations, equipment and evidence capture.
- Include operating-corner/load/orientation tests, conditional current-budget closure, exact-device fault review prerequisites, controlled fault/recovery tests, risk owners and objective stop/acceptance criteria.
- Include a provisional small-batch prototype order plan with exact BOM quantities, manufacturing/hole/outline checks, quote/availability gates and explicit user approval before any order.
- Add the Stage 8 plan status and reference to docs/SPEC.md, plus recorded decisions/constraints and a completed software-stage task checklist.
- Retain unchanged hardware/firmware/export sources, all four intrinsic J1 findings, all physical tests as NOT RUN, and original native verification/finish gates.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Read current design intent and confirm actual parts, nets, firmware applicability and fresh native verification reports.
- [ ] Write the complete ordered development/bring-up plan, existing-pad test map, evidence matrix, risk register and provisional prototype order plan.
- [ ] Update the authoritative specification pointer/status and record planning decisions/constraints without changing hardware targets or export sources.
- [ ] Read back the written documents, reconcile affected-file obligations and run required drift/ERC/DRC/legibility checks.
- [ ] Mark only plan/software work complete and pass the original finish gate, retaining every physical test and release hold as pending.
